The R21/Matrix-M vaccine demonstrated high effectiveness in clinical trials across sub-Saharan Africa.
The primary Phase 3 efficacy trial enrolled 4,800 children aged 5–36 months across multiple sites in four African countries.

citations.quote: Today, peer-reviewed results from a Phase 3 efficacy trial of the R21/Matrix-M™ malaria vaccine were published in The Lancet. The trial was conducted across multiple sites in four African countries with 4,800 children aged 5-36 months.
